name: Renewable Grid Operation and Control
description: Overview of interconnected power system operation, Load frequency control of power system, Optimal scheduling in power system: Unit commitment, Economic dispatch, Advanced power flow analysis, Power system security, State estimation, Optimal power flow (OPF and SCOPF), Security constrained unit commitment (SCUC), Renewable generation technologies (wind and solar) integration into the grid, Overview of power system restructuring – electricity markets and deregulation, Impact of renewable integration on aforementioned grid operations.
